name: Commander One
price: Free version; PRO Pack $29.99 personal (1 Mac) or $99.99 team (5 Macs), one-time; MAS: free with in-app purchase or 'Commander One PRO' $29.99
summary: Total Commander-style dual-pane file manager for macOS with function-key workflow, regex search, a built-in F3 viewer (text, hex, image, media) and archive handling. The PRO Pack adds RAR/7z, FTP/SFTP, cloud drives, terminal and themes.
where_it_wins: Classic F-key commander workflow and operations queue
Regex and content search, also inside archives and on FTP
PRO: FTP/SFTP and many cloud services, MTP/iOS/Android devices
where_schnellbild_wins: All features free, no PRO upsell; RAR and 7z included
Real image and video viewer with slideshow and full-size paging
Photo/video thumbnail grid with folder previews
Comics CBZ/CBR, videos straight from archives

free.note: Free version (dual pane, basic file ops, ZIP only); PRO Pack $29.99 personal / $99.99 team (5 Macs), one-time

native_apple_silicon.note: 'Optimized for both Apple silicon and Intel'

no_account_no_tracking.note: App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected; no account needed; free version shows PRO upsell

dark_light_setting.note: Color themes incl. light and dark; custom themes in PRO

languages_20.note: 14 languages (CS, NL, EN, FR, DE, HU, IT, JA, KO, PL, PT, ZH, ES, UK); UI language selectable

thumbnail_grid.note: 'Thumbs' view mode; no folder preview thumbnails

list_view.note: Full and Brief modes with columns

recursive_search.note: Search with depth limit, in archives, on FTP; also Spotlight

regex_search.note: RegEx option in file search (also in the free version)

network_shares_fast.note: SMB/NetBIOS, FTP, cloud supported; no specific speed claim

multiple_windows.note: File > New Window (since 1.1); tabs per pane

img_modern_formats.note: Quick Look/built-in viewer image mode with macOS codecs; no dedicated image viewer

img_raw.note: Via image/media viewer modes and Quick Look, i.e. macOS system RAW support; no own decoder

img_psd_exr.note: No source names PSD/OpenEXR; searched manual, version history, feature pages

img_svg_pdf.note: SVG/PDF preview not named; searched manual, version history, feature pages

img_animated.note: Animated images not documented; searched manual, version history

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom only via Quick Look (Command-Plus/Minus); F3 image mode has no documented zoom

slideshow.note: No slideshow in manual or version history; whether its Quick Look window offers the macOS full-screen slideshow is not documented

slideshow_recursive.note: No slideshow feature in manual or version history
